description.title: חישוב סכומי ביטוח
description.summary: This table details how insurance sums, limits of liability, and deductibles are calculated when denominated in currencies other than the policy schedule currency. It specifies using the Bank of Israel's representative exchange rate.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את אופן חישוב סכומי הביטוח, מגבלי האחריות וההשתתפות העצמית כאשר הם מצוינים במטבע שונה מהמטבע המפורט בתוכנית הביטוח. החישוב מתבצע על פי שער החליפין היציג של בנק ישראל. פוליסת מכלול קובעת כי סכומים המפורטים בדולרים אמריקאיים יחושבו לפי שער הדולר בבנק ישראל ביום החישוב או התשלום. סכומים במטבע אחר יחושבו לפי השער היציג של בנק ישראל לאותו מטבע ביחס למטבע המפורט בתוכנית, ביום קרות האירוע הביטוחי. מכלול מתייחסת לחישוב סכומי ביטוח, מגבלי אחריות והשתתפות עצמית.
notable_values: US dollars: Bank of Israel representative rate
Other currency: Bank of Israel exchange rate
Calculation date: date of occurrence of the insured event

9.13.2 If the sums insured or limits of liability and deductible are denominated in US dollars, same -including the insurance benefits due to the insured or the beneficiary (as the case may be) -shall be calculated in US dollars according to the representative rate of the dollar with the Bank of Israel, applying on the date of calculation or actual payment (as the case may be).
9.13.3 If the policy notes a sum insured, limit of liability or deductible sum in a currency other than that specified in the schedule, said sum shall be calculated in accordance with the representative exchange rate published by the Bank of Israel for such currency into the currency noted in the schedule on the date of the occurrence of the insured event.

טבלה: חישוב סכומי ביטוח
This table details how insurance sums, limits of liability, and deductibles are calculated when denominated in currencies other than the policy schedule currency. It specifies using the Bank of Israel's representative exchange rate.
ממדים: Currency conversion scenarios, Calculation method

9.13.2 If the sums insured or limits of liability and deductible are denominated in US dollars, same -including the insurance benefits due to the insured or the beneficiary (as the case may be) -shall be calculated in US dollars according to the representative rate of the dollar with the Bank of Israel, applying on the date of calculation or actual payment (as the case may be).
9.13.3 If the policy notes a sum insured, limit of liability or deductible sum in a currency other than that specified in the schedule, said sum shall be calculated in accordance with the representative exchange rate published by the Bank of Israel for such currency into the currency noted in the schedule on the date of the occurrence of the insured event.
